title: MOSOKO_Portuguese_Ol_fe921b5f
style: Educational children's pop with a bright, upbeat arrangement. Acoustic guitar strums rhythmic eighth-note patterns. Electric bass plays a melodic, walking line that follows the chord progression. A standard drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with crisp hi-hats and a punchy kick. Bright, clean male vocals lead the track, supported by group backing vocals in the chorus. The arrangement features occasional synthesized bell accents and a light shaker. Key of G major. Tempo is 128 BPM.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[acoustic guitar strumming, upbeat drums, bass enters]
Olá!
That's where it starts
One word opens every heart

[Chorus]
[group vocals join]
Olá, hello in Portuguese (yee-hee!)
Obrigado, thank you with ease (woo!)
Por favor, please with care
Até logo, see you there

[Verse 1]
[bright synth bell accents]
Olá, como vai? How are you?
Prazer em te conhecer, nice to meet you
Até mais, see you soon
Socorro, help me too

[Verse 2]
Desculpe, I'm sorry friend
De nada, no problem blend
Onde fica? Where is it?
Água, banheiro, basics visit

[Outro]
[music continues with acoustic guitar and drums]
Olá, obrigado, por favor, até logo!
